name: Forma Studio
summary: Quiet interior and architecture studio site: a dark full-bleed interior photo hero with an edge-to-edge wordmark at its foot, pale grey editorial sections, a staggered project gallery, sticky service cards on near-black and a line-drawn floor plan process grid.

fonts.pairing: Mona Sans 500 at -0.04em for 48 to 76px heads, 400 at 20 to 24px for statements; counters set in a monospaced face for a drafted, technical note

signature: wordmark set edge to edge along the bottom of the hero photo and again as a giant footer sign-off
staggered project gallery: pairs of images at different widths, then one centred wide image, each with name left and year right
service cards that stick on scroll in a right column while the section head stays pinned left
process grid alternating text cells and cells of white line-drawn floor plans and isometric room renders
imagery: moody, warm-lit interior and architecture renders in browns, ambers and charcoal; square corners; line-art plans as illustration
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 80px side padding, 120px section padding, 4-column process grid with 1px dark borders, no radii
